test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As of 2022, there are ______ states in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**28**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Currently India has a total of **28 states and 8 Union Territories**.
 
• With effect from October **31st, 2019** the state of Jammu and Kashmir has been officially bifurcated into the Union Territories of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.
 
• Currently 8 Union Territories are
 
 
• **Andaman and Nicobar Islands**
 
• **Chandigarh**
 
• **Dadra Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu**
 
• **Delhi**
 
• **Jammu & Kashmir**
 
• **Ladakh**
 
• **Puducherry**
 
• **Lakshadweep **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• With the States **Reorganisation Act, of 1956** and, the **7th Constitutional Amendment Act 1956,** the distinction between Part A, and Part B states was done away with, and Part C states were abolished.
 
• On **1 November 1956**, **14 states and 6 union territories** were created.
 
• **Andhra Pradesh** was the first state of independent India formed on a linguistic basis it was formed on **October 1, 1953.**
